hero: A district hospital ward in Nueva Vizcaya on a rainy afternoon: a puffy-eyed 4-year-old Filipino boy with a swollen abdomen rests on his mother's lap, and a pediatric nephrologist kneels to press his fingertip to check capillary refill while a nurse holds a syringe tray to one side, waiting. Soft natural light, no text.

figures.teaches: Podocyte injury causes albumin loss, and edema forms through both underfill and primary sodium retention.
figures.content: Top: glomerular capillary wall with three layers labeled 'Endothelium', 'Basement membrane', 'Podocyte'; healthy foot processes with 'Slit diaphragm (nephrin)' versus flattened foot processes labeled 'Antinephrin antibodies'. Arrow 'Albumin leaks' to urine. Two branches: left 'Underfill: low oncotic pressure -> volume falls -> renin, aldosterone up'; right 'Overfill: filtered plasmin -> ENaC on -> sodium retained'. Both arrows converge on 'Edema'. Small box 'Hengel 2024: 52% of children with INS'.

figures.teaches: Underfilled children need albumin and no diuretic; overfilled children can take diuretics.
figures.content: Two side-by-side child figures. Left labeled 'Underfilled': icons 'Fast heart rate', 'Cold hands', 'Capillary refill slow', 'Tummy pain', 'Little urine', 'FENa below 0.2%'; bottom 'No diuretic. Albumin per protocol'. Right labeled 'Overfilled': 'Normal heart rate', 'Warm hands', 'Blood pressure high', 'Urine sodium higher'; bottom 'Diuretic with salt restriction'.

figures.teaches: The IPNA 2022 definitions name the response and the course from dated events.
figures.content: Horizontal timeline from 'Start steroid' with markers 'Week 4: complete remission = SSNS', 'Weeks 4-6: confirmation period', 'Week 6: late responder or SRNS'. Below, three definition boxes: 'Relapse: 3+ for 3 days', 'Frequent relapses: 2 in 6 months or 3 in 12 months', 'Steroid dependent: 2 relapses on steroid or within 14 days'. Footer 'Use the course classifier; no doses'.

card: A swollen-faced preschool boy on his mother's lap while a doctor gently checks his fingertip.
